title: Among the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations by port count—con
question: Among the top 10 (port status, device owner) combinations by port count—considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')—show the number of ports and the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and also indicate whether that port status has any ports with an IP allocation of 10.150.64.113/8 (and if so, include the variance of the standard attribute ID for that status). Do not return any rounded answers.

access_trace.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner AS device_owner,
    COUNT(p.id) AS port_count,
    MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_update
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id 
      FROM networkrbacs nr 
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared' 
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
  ORDER BY port_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
status_variance AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status,
    VARIANCE(sa.id) AS std_attr_id_variance
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id 
      FROM networkrbacs nr 
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared' 
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
  GROUP BY p.status
)
SELECT 
  b.port_status,
  b.device_owner,
  b.port_count,
  b.earliest_standard_attr_update,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM ports p2
      JOIN ipallocations ia ON p2.id = ia.port_id
      WHERE p2.status = b.port_status
        AND ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
    ) THEN 'Yes' 
    ELSE 'No' 
  END AS has_ip_allocation,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM ports p2
      JOIN ipallocations ia ON p2.id = ia.port_id
      WHERE p2.status = b.port_status
        AND ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
    ) THEN sv.std_attr_id_variance
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS std_attr_id_variance
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN status_variance sv ON b.port_status = sv.status
ORDER BY b.port_count DESC
